data.narrative:
Breaker Industries is a seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Stark Defence, UFORCE, Singularity, NODA AI) with valuations ranging from $125M to $4.0B, supplemented by reference to a broader competitive set of eight private firms and two public defense contractors (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using the $6M total raised as a value proxy and applying a typical 2.5x seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implied a valuation of $15M. The peer-median method across the four same-sector comparables yielded a median valuation of $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The disparity between these methods reflects the significant heterogeneity in the Defense & Security sector at seed and early stages, where valuation outcomes depend heavily on technology differentiation, founder pedigree, and customer traction signals not captured in stage alone.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $13M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $358M. The wide range reflects genuine uncertainty around Breaker's positioning within the sector. Key determinants include the company's specific technical capabilities, existing customer commitments, and competitive positioning relative to the cited peer set.
